note: Raw inbound events, one per subject. These carry names on purpose: they are
the input to the trust boundary, and the point of the fixture set is that
The text is written the way hospital operational messages actually read,
with the obligation implied rather than stated. An event that says 'create a
task to chase the pre-auth' would be testing nothing; the interpreter's job
is to notice the commitment nobody wrote down.
